networks.name: receipt_notary
networks.description: An independent open agentic peer site that performs deterministic receipt-digest checks in the caller's browser and proves that no caller key or private context is required.

llm_router.note: This peer never selects a router for a caller. Its keyless default exists only so the site can be inspected and run independently.

peer_policy.note: This leaf peer does not contact other agent sites.
